name: plan-coverage-change-boundary
body: Scope boundary (prose; assessed by review): this change-set changes ONLY the plan-verify derived-coverage scope computation and the tests that pin it. It does not change the planned-node realization gate, the feedback-resolution gate, the durable node/edge write surface, the suite tools (`apg_plan_*` — including `apg_plan_phases`'s own project/requirement scoping), or `apg plan verify`'s CLI/exit surface; the coverage refusal keeps naming the owning solution node and the uncovered code FQN.
